text: Revised Attendance Rule for all students w.e.f. AY 2025-26 2.1 Attendance rules for all schools To ensure satisfactory attendance and engagement, 100% attendance in all subjects/courses is expected. However, exceptions can be made for valid medical reasons, personal reasons, and participation in extra- curricular and co-curricular activities, placement activities, institutional work, and other approved activities. A relaxation of up to 20% absence may be granted in such cases. 2.1.1 Eligibility for Examinations: Students who have maintained 80% or higher attendance in individual courses during a trimester/semester are eligible to appear for the respective trimester/semester-end examinations. Attendance is considered from the date of commencement of each semester/trimester.

Introduction to the Course 1.1 Importance of the Course 1.1.1 Domain Relevance: Physics is one of the most fundamental scientific disciplines for the Engineers, and its main goal is to understand how the universe behaves and how to bring advancement in technology. Study of physics develops the ability of Problem Solving, Logical Thinking and also the Ability to think intellectually on practical issues. This course aims to equip students with the physics fundamental for their smooth technical journey. 1.1.2 Industry Relevance: Most of the industries rely on strong understanding of physics principles like waves and oscillations, fundamental properties of materials, electricity and magnetism. These principles support the operation of countless technologies from internal combustion engines to semiconductors in computers and smart phones.

Importance of the course. This course helps student to understand fundamental principles of Electrical and Engineering. Also it provides an overview of evolution of Electronics, and introduce the working principle and examples of fundamental electronics devices and circuits to make students understand the impact of technology in a global and societal context.

This course helps student to understand fundamental principles of Electrical and Engineering. Also it provides an overview of evolution of Electronics, and introduce the working principle and examples of fundamental electronics devices and circuits to make students understand the impact of technology in a global and societal context. At the end of the course, the student is expected to know the fundamental of Electrical and Electronics Engineering as well as practical implementation of fundamental theory concepts in day to day life.. Objective of the Course. The main objective of this course is to equip the students with the ability to solve, assemble and test simple AC and DC electrical circuits. SVKM'S NMIMS Deemed to beUNIVERSITY Strict Adherence to Academic Integrity and Consequences of Unfair Means in University Examinations Dear Students, We have observed many instances of students of NMIMS adopting unfair means during the University examinations. We would like to emphasize the gravity of this matter and the severe implications it can have on your academic journey and future endeavours. The use of unfair means, such as cheating, plagiarism, or any form of academic dishonesty during examinations, is a direct violation of the principles of academic integrity. We want to remind all students that maintaining academic integrity is not only a fundamental value of our Institution but also a crucial aspect of personal and professional development. Implications of Adopting Unfair Means: 1. Impact on Results, Grades, GPA, and CGPA: Any student found guilty of adopting unfair means during examinations will face disciplinary actions.

Implications of Adopting Unfair Means: 1. Impact on Results, Grades, GPA, and CGPA: Any student found guilty of adopting unfair means during examinations will face disciplinary actions. The consequences may include, but are not limited to, the nullification of the exam concerned or complete semester/ trimester appearance, not allowing student concerned to appear at any subsequent examination/ s. This, in turn, adversely affects your GPA and CGPA. 2. Impact on Placements: Employers value integrity, and instances of academic dishonesty can significantly impact your chances during job placements. A tarnished academic record may lead to decreased opportunities and a negative perception from potential employers.

Impact on Placements: Employers value integrity, and instances of academic dishonesty can significantly impact your chances during job placements. A tarnished academic record may lead to decreased opportunities and a negative perception from potential employers. 3. Impact on Admission to Overseas Universities: Academic institutions worldwide prioritize applicants with a strong record of academic honesty. Instances of adopting unfair means during examinations may result in rejection or withdrawal of admission offers from overseas universities, hindering your chances of pursuing further education abroad. 4.

Instances of adopting unfair means during examinations may result in rejection or withdrawal of admission offers from overseas universities, hindering your chances of pursuing further education abroad. 4. Impact on Dean's List/ Meritorious List: The involvement of deserving students in unfair activities, due to their negligence, results in their names being removed from the Dean's / Meritorious List. We earnestly advise all students to refrain from using unfair means during University examinations. Instead, focus on developing effective study habits, time management skills, and seek support from faculty members or counselling services if you are feeling overwhelmed due to various pressures. Handling stress and pressure is an essential skill in both academic and professional life.

Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], September 8: The School of Business Management (SBM) at SVKM’s NMIMS University has earned a place among the world’s leading business schools in the Financial Times Masters in Management (MiM) Ranking 2026, reinforcing its continued standing among globally recognised institutions for management education.
